_configurationInfo.text: Create and manage heating schedules in the Device Manager tab on the left. Each schedule contains its heating modes.

configurationBackupDelayMinutes.label: Backup delay in minutes
configurationBackupDelayMinutes.help: The timer starts when the adapter starts and restarts after every schedule configuration change. Set to 0 to disable automatic backups.

result.backupUpdated: The schedule configuration backup was updated.
result.backupCurrent: The schedule configuration backup is already up to date.

confirm.title: Restore schedule configuration?
confirm.text: The current schedule configuration will be replaced by the backup.

result.backupRestored: The schedule configuration backup was restored.
result.backupMissing: No schedule configuration backup is available.
